title: From Shawee to Sugar Boy and the Cane Cutters
summary: The name was cut down on the contract, he signed as leader under his childhood nickname, and Chess added Cane Cutters.

bands.name: Sugar Boy and His Cane Cutters

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: When did y'all break up the group?

Well, we didn't really. We had to change the name because of the length of the name. When I got a chance to sign a recording contract, the man didn't want to use the name Shafaka Shaowee on the record. So he just used part of it, Shaowee. And then when I, then it came down and got down to the place where as he only wanted to sign one person to the contract. And since I was the leader of the band, I signed the contract. And he used the nickname that I had since I was a small kid, Sugar Boy. And this is how that got started.
How did you get the name Sugar Boy?

I don't know. I don't think it had anything to do with my mother and father. It's just something that all like who's coming up, we all had nicknames. And this was my nickname. So this is what happened.
So the cane cutters evolved from your name Sugar Bowl?

Now when I, when I recorded my first number for Leonard Chess on the checker recording. And he, he put the name Sugar Boy on the record and he wanted to name the band. So he just put cane cutters to go along with the Sugar Boy. So he, he wrote a little article in the magazine, say that the name came by me. I was, I was born in the country, raised up in the country. And, and I got the nickname because I used to eat sugarcane.
